summary: First-run full-stack test of DT Inspection app. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (auth, RBAC on companies/sites/users/masters, ICE=29 & EV=37 checklist, inspection create/list/approve, recap+CSV export, upload/download of PNG, non-image rejected, dashboard). Frontend: login (admin+driver via demo buttons and form), dashboard stat cards, sidebar RBAC (admin has no nav-companies/nav-sites), EN/ID language toggle (Dashboard <-> Beranda), Trucks master CRUD (add/save/delete with confirm), Driver new inspection flow (29 ICE cards, progress text updates, NOT_OK reveals note textarea, submit navigates to detail page), driver hides approval-card, admin sees approval-card + approve button flips status to 'Approved' with approver name, recap matrix shows 5 truck rows incl DT-001, summary tab renders, CSV export buttons present, mobile viewport status pills are 44px tall.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 643 lines and OK, but the generic register_master() inner endpoints share function names (_list/_create/_update/_delete) across 3 registrations; not a bug but relies on FastAPI resolving via path only.

GET /api/inspections/{id_} route is defined after /api/inspections/checklist so ordering is fine, but be aware /inspections/{id_} would match /inspections/checklist if declared in wrong order; current ordering is correct.
auth/logout is a no-op (JWT stored client-side) - acceptable but consider token revocation list for security-hardening.
recap max range 92 days is fine; consider capping export size too.
Frontend: login-email input testid is 'login-email-input' (not 'login-email' as sometimes referenced); could be normalized.
test_credentials: superadmin oktavio.rei@gmail.com/Admin@1234; admin admin@iti.demo/Admin@1234; driver driver@iti.demo/Driver@1234
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/delete TEST_ prefixed companies/sites/users/trucks and one inspection on DT-002. The inspection created during frontend testing was approved by admin and remains in DB (defect_count=1, TEST defect note). Safe to leave; no seeded data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~6s (28 tests, xdist parallel). Login testids are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-btn (not the shorter names in some docs). Radix Select options use `<trigger-testid>-opt-<value>` (e.g., form-truck-opt-DT-002). Recap page requires an admin session; superadmin needs site_id query param.
